propositions: resolve_event_commit and resolve_position_commit are missing --no-renames and -c log.showSignature=false flags that bulk map builders already carry
On hosts with log.showSignature=true and signed commits, missing log.showSignature=false causes gpg: lines to interleave into stdout, making lines[-1] return non-SHA instead of valid commit SHA
Adding --no-renames is behaviour-preserving because positions are globally unique and event-file renames (.json to .json.retired) do not match *.json pathspecs
--no-merges must not be added because the fallback mechanism specifically catches files added only in merge commits
